Black Sigil - Blade of the Exiled.name: Black Sigil: Blade of the Exiled
Black Sigil - Blade of the Exiled.summary:
Bel Lenora is a world where people are born with magic at their command. Years ago, a single man walked the land with no magic in his veins. He brought death and tragedy in his wake and was banished by a brave General at a great cost. It has been fifteen years since his banishment and once again, a young man with no magic walks the land of Bel Lenora.

Join Kairu, a young knight, born with a cursed spirit...

Metal Saga - Hagane no Kisetsu.name: Metal Saga: Hagane no Kisetsu
Metal Saga - Hagane no Kisetsu.summary:
Metal Saga: Hagane no Kisetsu (Japanese: メタルサーガ ～鋼の季節～, literally Metal Saga: Season of Steel) is a post-apocalyptic role-playing video game developed by Crea-Tech and published by Success in 2006. It running in Nintendo DS and it is a full touch screen controlled game.

Metal Saga: Hagane no Kisetsu is the fifth game of Metal Max series. Unlike its predecessor Metal Saga, the game wasn't released in North America. And in 2007, a sequel was released on mobile phone as an incarnation of Metal Saga and was released in Japan in 2007.

This entry is very different with original games. For example, multiple characters sit in only a tank instead of one person sit in one, and using "durability" instead of tank's armor.

My Friends.name: My Friends
My Friends.summary: Explore the My Friends world and create your own friends! Ever wanted a friend with blue skin, red hair, silly hat & pink shoes?! In My Friends you can create anything you want! Once you have made friends keep them all happy by playing games with them, sharing gifts and generally having fun!

Petz Rescue - Ocean Patrol.name: Petz Rescue Ocean Patrol
Petz Rescue - Ocean Patrol.summary: Petz Rescue: Ocean Sanctuary is an adventure game in which players manage a dolphin sanctuary for displaced or wounded ocean animals. Players complete various tasks and participate in mini-games, while learning about the plight of endangered species. Tasks/mini-games include tending to the wounds of dolphins, feeding dolphins, preparing medicine, and locating lost animals.

Profesor Layton y la Caja de Pandora, El.name: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
Profesor Layton y la Caja de Pandora, El.summary: Professor Layton may be a world-famous sleuth, but even he will need your assistance to crack these challenging puzzles. With Nintendo DS stylus in hand, it's time to muster up some mental might!

SpongeBob SquarePants Featuring Nicktoon.name: SpongeBob SquarePants featuring Nicktoons: Globs of Doom
SpongeBob SquarePants Featuring Nicktoon.summary: Nintendo DS port of SpongeBob SquarePants featuring Nicktoons: Globs of Doom.

Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue.name: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue.summary: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue on Nintendo DS invites players to create their own fairy and fly into Fairy Camp and adventure through the English countryside and explore all new locations to find and grow the rare Rainbow Lily. Players will interact with Lizzy and team up with fairy friends to bring each of the six rare lilies to Fairy Camp. Along the way, fans will complete quests and take part in a wide variety of mini-games that will use specific fairy talents for arts and crafts, baking and decorating cookies and more. Connect to all the fun in Pixiehollow.com with new online connectivity features!

Trick - DS Ban - Kakushigami no Sumu Yak.name: Trick DS Ban: Kakushigami no Sumu Yakata
Trick - DS Ban - Kakushigami no Sumu Yak.summary: A series of mysterious disappearances occur in an old mansion in a mountain village. Based on the Japanese TV drama TRICK, the player can investigate as either aspiring magician Naoko or skeptical physicist Ueda, working together to collect evidence and testimony from witnesses, track down the real culprit, and uncover the hidden 'trick' to the supposedly supernatural happenings.

Unsolved Crimes.name: Unsolved Crimes
Unsolved Crimes.summary: The game is set in New York City. The player is a rookie detective from the homicide division. There are eight cases in the game, and one larger case divided into sections. In this case, a model named Betsy Blake goes missing. She is the sister of the player's partner, Marcy Blake.
